[[Named item sets#Guardian of the Gates|Guardian of the Gates]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Guardian of the Gates|Guardian of the Gates]]:''' While wearing three items from the Guardian of the Gates set, you gain:
+10% Artifact bonus to Armor Class
+5 Artifact bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
+15 Artifact bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
+75% Artifact bonus to Melee Threat Generation
+10% Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Acid, and Electric Absorption
